spells.name: Poison Swamp
spells.desc: Conjure a poison spring on one tile. The toxin overflows onto the surrounding ground and runs downhill. Enemies caught in the spreading poison take damage; the terrain poisons anyone who wades through. Flyers up in the sky are above it.

spells.name: Shed Skin
spells.desc: Leave a decoy, cleanse 1 debuff, teleport 2 tiles away. Decoy draws 1 attack.

spells.name: Smoke Screen
spells.desc: Blanket a 3×3 area in smoke for 2 turns. Allies inside are hidden and stay invisible only while they remain in the cloud.

spells.name: Sneak Slash
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage while invisible. Deals bonus damage to Poisoned targets.

spells.name: Tongue Lash
spells.desc: Faster than the eye. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy within 4, drags it up to 3 tiles toward you and Poisons it for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Misdirection
spells.desc: Look — over there. Blinds a Single Enemy within 3 for 2 rounds: its attacks miss half the time.

spells.name: Sucker Punch
spells.desc: They never saw it coming. Literally. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to an adjacent enemy. Deals bonus damage to Blinded targets. Breaks it for 1 round (its passives are off; a passive flyer falls).

spells.name: Heat Ray
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Burn.

spells.name: Gravity Boots
spells.desc: Activate anti-gravity boots to reposition up to 3 tiles. Far out.

spells.name: Plasma Whip
spells.desc: The whip cracks down the lane. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to All Enemies in a line up to 3 tiles long and sets them alight. It reaches further than it should and burns where it lands.

spells.name: Sneak Slash
spells.desc: Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage while invisible. Deals bonus damage to Poisoned targets.

spells.name: Photon Scatter
spells.desc: Deals WEAK magic damage to All Enemies around the caster (AOE).

spells.name: Love Bite
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Lowers the target's DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Fire Arrow
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Burn.

spells.name: Steal from the Rich
spells.desc: Steal from the rich. Lowers a Single Enemy's ATK by 1 stage and takes it for yourself.

spells.name: Splitting Arrow
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy, then bounces to one nearby enemy. Deals bonus damage to targets with Burn.

spells.name: Arrow Volley
spells.desc: Loose high and let gravity do the rest. HEAVY physical damage to every enemy in a 3×3 up to 6 tiles away. The arrows come down over any wall.

spells.name: Snare
spells.desc: A loop of wire where the game walks. The first thing that steps in it is not going anywhere for 2 rounds. Hides a snare on an empty tile within 3; the enemy cannot see it. The first enemy to step on it takes WEAK physical damage and is Rooted for 2 rounds. Two snares per caster.

spells.name: Kneecap Shot
spells.desc: Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Rooted.

spells.name: Prism Mirror
spells.desc: Fold a laser-reflecting prism into being on an empty tile (up to 8) for just 1 AP. Folding never ends your turn or uses your spell slot, so you can fold another, Pulse Lattice, move or attack with the AP you have left. Beams auto-connect any of your prisms that share a row or column — enemies that path through a beam are seared, and enemies still standing in one at end of round take burn damage. A prism is sturdy glass: it takes two hits to shatter.

spells.name: Pulse Lattice
spells.desc: Discharge the lattice (needs 3+ prisms): every enemy caught on a beam takes a burst in the current frequency. 4+ prisms across 2+ elevations enclose a 3-D volume — everyone inside is hit and the burst is amplified. 8 prisms in a perfect rectangular prism unleash a massive detonation through the whole volume.

spells.name: Tune Frequency
spells.desc: Shift your whole lattice to the next light frequency — Infrared (fire, burns), Ultraviolet (arcane, shreds DEF), or Gamma (charged, slows) — changing what every one of your beams does. Only once per round.

spells.name: Ego Death
spells.desc: Dissolve the target's sense of self entirely. The world drains away, the colour wheel spins, and what is left of "them" implodes into white light. Deals SEVERE magic damage to a Single Enemy and Stuns them while the pieces reassemble. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

spells.name: Visible Language
spells.desc: They sing, and the song is a solid object. Deals WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy within 4 and Discords them for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Mirror Blink
spells.desc: Fold through the light and blink to any tile within 3 — reposition inside your own lattice, or slip out of a collapsing trap.

spells.name: Dimensional Fold
spells.desc: Swaps positions with the target unit.

spells.name: Prism Mirror
spells.desc: Fold a laser-reflecting prism into being on an empty tile (up to 8) for just 1 AP. Folding never ends your turn or uses your spell slot, so you can fold another, Pulse Lattice, move or attack with the AP you have left. Beams auto-connect any of your prisms that share a row or column — enemies that path through a beam are seared, and enemies still standing in one at end of round take burn damage. A prism is sturdy glass: it takes two hits to shatter.

spells.name: Stone Skin
spells.desc: Empowers the caster. Raises DEF by 1 stage.

spells.name: Calcify
spells.desc: Turn the target's thoughts to stone. Grey creeps up from their skull as the mind petrifies — lowers M ATK by 2 stages.

spells.name: Petrify
spells.desc: Grey climbs from the feet up. For two rounds they are a statue; when it lets go, the cracks stay. Stuns a Single Enemy for 2 rounds and lowers DEF by 1 stage. Cooldown: 2 rounds.

spells.name: Mirror Blink
spells.desc: Fold through the light and blink to any tile within 3 — reposition inside your own lattice, or slip out of a collapsing trap.

spells.name: Sad Backstory
spells.desc: It all comes back. Raises the caster's ATK by 1 stage — by 2 stages while under 50% HP.

spells.name: Plot Armor
spells.desc: The hero cannot die yet. The next killing blow leaves the caster at 1 HP instead.

spells.name: To Be Continued
spells.markLogText: freezes the frame on {target} — the episode resumes at the end of the round, and the finishing strike lands with it.
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy. Marks the target: the hit lands at the end of the round, but only while your team can still see them.

spells.name: Roll Credits
spells.desc: This is the part where it ends. Deals HEAVY physical damage to a Single Enemy. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Cross Slash
spells.desc: The X-cut that will not close. Deals MEDIUM physical damage to a Single Enemy and leaves it Grievously Wounded: healing is halved.

spells.name: Sprint
spells.desc: Go. Runs up to 3 tiles in a straight line.
Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy. Applies Stagger. The caster charges into melee first.
spells.name: Gore Charge
Treeline Scream
spells.desc: Half bleat, half a man screaming. Every enemy within 1 tile is Feared for a round. Cooldown: 3 rounds.

spells.name: Life Sap
spells.desc: Deals MEDIUM magic damage to a Single Enemy. Heals the caster for part of the damage dealt. Deals bonus damage to targets with Poison.
Dashes through the battlefield. Deals bonus damage to targets with Discord. The caster charges into melee first.
spells.name: Bull Rush
Hatchet Throw
spells.desc: Out of the dark, end over end. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy within 4 and makes them Bleed for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Horn Toss
spells.desc: A true toss. Deals WEAK physical damage to a Single Enemy and throws it 3 tiles whichever way you pick (click the target, then a tile beside it). Slamming into something hurts more. Deals bonus damage to Staggered targets.

spells.name: Blood Ritual
spells.desc: Empowers the caster. Raises ATK by 1 stage. Costs a portion of your HP.

spells.name: Soothe
spells.desc: A hand on the brow. It does not fix you; it keeps you going. Heals an ally a MEDIUM amount and gives them Regen for 2 rounds.

spells.name: Heal
spells.desc: Restores a LARGE amount of HP to a Single Ally. Heals more on allies below 40% HP.

spells.name: Temporal Tide
spells.desc: Time runs thick in the water. Creates a 3×3 zone for 2 rounds: allies inside heal a WEAK amount and shed 1 debuff at the end of each round; enemies inside are Slowed.

spells.name: Revive
spells.desc: Revives a fallen ally. Works once per unit per match.

spells.name: Tube Feet
spells.desc: A thousand little suckers. Deals WEAK physical damage to an adjacent enemy and Roots it for a round.

spells.name: Water Jet
spells.desc: A hard jet of water from the open hand. WEAK magic damage to a Single Enemy within 3 and it is Soaked for 2 rounds.
